meta.description: Randomly snaps off branches or stems at the selected depth level

probability.description: Chance that a path is snapped

depth.description: On which layer of paths the snap happens

lowestSnap.description: Lowest point along the path where a snap can occur. 0 = base, 1 = tip.

highestSnap.description: Highest point along the path where a snap can occur. 0 = base, 1 = tip.
